name: Irrigation
visible_upgrade: Fields turn greener — irrigation channels trace the plains
description: Channel river water to arid fields, boosting staple yields.

name: Crop Rotation
visible_upgrade: Patchwork greens deepen — rotated fields checker the valley
description: Three-field rotation restores soil fertility and steadies harvests.

name: Fertilization
visible_upgrade: Earth darkens richly — compost and manure feed the soil
description: Systematic manuring and composting lifts every bushel.

name: Granaries
visible_upgrade: Silhouettes of raised granaries dot hamlets — storage gleams
description: Raised stone granaries cut spoilage and carry winter stores.

name: Selective Breeding
visible_upgrade: Taller wheat sways — bred strains wave golden-green
description: Careful seed and stock selection hardens crops and livestock.

name: Golden Harvest
visible_upgrade: Plains shimmer amber at harvest — the realm is ever-fertile
description: The pinnacle of agronomy — abundance even in lean winters.

name: Militia Drill
visible_upgrade: Palisades sharpen — drill yards dust the hamlet edge
description: Every village fields trained levies, not just farmers with pitchforks.

name: Forge Arms
visible_upgrade: Smithies glow hotter — steel rims the barracks
description: Standardized forging puts steel in every hand.

name: Fortification
visible_upgrade: Stone walls climb — ramparts cast clean shadows
description: Curtain walls and towers anchor every settlement.

name: Cavalry Doctrine
visible_upgrade: Stables widen — hoof-trodden rings mark the field
description: Shock cavalry tactics and breeding turn horses into weapons.

name: Siege Engineering
visible_upgrade: Trebuchet frames loom on drill hills — timber stacks rise
description: Counterweights and sappers reduce any wall on paper first.

name: Elite Guard
visible_upgrade: Banners snap crisper — elite colors mark the citadel
description: A household guard whose oath alone steadies the realm.

name: Market Charter
visible_upgrade: Market cloths brighten — stalls crowd the square
description: A chartered market draws peddlers to every crossroads.

name: Coinage
visible_upgrade: Gold glints warmer on ledger — coin feels weightier
description: Uniform coinage and mints stabilize exchange.

name: Trade Routes
visible_upgrade: Dust roads darken with traffic — caravan ruts score the land
description: Protected routes link river, road and sea.

name: Guilds
visible_upgrade: Workshop shutters multiply — guild signs swing in rows
description: Craft guilds enforce quality and apprentice the young.

name: Banking
visible_upgrade: Ledgers gleam — banking halls add marble to market
description: Bills of exchange and vaults move fortunes without moving metal.

name: Mercantile Empire
visible_upgrade: Harbor and caravanserai glow — commerce gilds the horizon
description: Your merchants price grain in three kingdoms at once.

name: Masonry
visible_upgrade: Stone cuts cleaner — roofs sit straighter on foundations
description: Dressed stone and mortar replace wattle where it matters.

name: Aqueduct
visible_upgrade: Pale arches thread hills — water glints along high channels
description: Gravity-fed stone channels carry clean water to the thirsty.

name: Great Hall
visible_upgrade: Hall roofs broaden — timber halls warm the skyline
description: A vaulted hall for feasts, law and winter shelter.

name: Stone Roads
visible_upgrade: Roads pale to stone grey — cobbles grid the terrain
description: Paved ways unmire supply and speed the king's messengers.

name: Cathedral
visible_upgrade: Spires pierce mist — stained glass tints sunset
description: A house for the divine that steadies hearts and scribes alike.

name: Wonder
visible_upgrade: The wonder crowns the ridge — the world looks brighter
description: A wonder for the ages; travelers speak its name far away.

name: Herbalism
visible_upgrade: Meadows fleck violet — herb gardens haze blue-green
description: Tended beds of healing herbs and quiet hedge-wisdom.

name: Alchemy
visible_upgrade: Faint amber smoke curls from labs — dusk feels thicker
description: Distillations and salts that turn dross to value.

name: Astrology
visible_upgrade: Observatory domes catch starlight — nights deepen indigo
description: Charted heavens lend calendar certainty and awe.

name: Runic Lore
visible_upgrade: Runes etch faintly on stone — dusk shimmers rune-blue
description: Old signs awakened; they ward as much as they intrigue.

name: Elemental Binding
visible_upgrade: Wind visibly threads treetops — air feels charged
description: Bound currents turn mills without wind and kilns without coal.

name: Transmutation
visible_upgrade: The air itself takes a faint violet-gold sheen — wonder permeates
description: The high art: matter listens and rearranges.

name: Codified Law
visible_upgrade: Streets feel orderly — law stones stand at crossings
description: Written law lets strangers trust the same rules.

name: Bureaucracy
visible_upgrade: Couriers criss-cross — parchment paths link halls
description: Clerks and seals make the realm legible to its ruler.

name: Tax Reform
visible_upgrade: Markets feel fairer — stalls spread under steady levy
description: A just tally harvests more without bleeding the peasant.

name: Diplomatic Corps
visible_upgrade: Envoy banners flutter — distant colors join the square
description: Trained envoys turn letters into leverage.

name: Royal Academy
visible_upgrade: Academy lanterns warm nights — light spills scholarly
description: A crown-funded academy gathers wits and books.

name: Enlightened Rule
visible_upgrade: The realm feels luminous — order and curiosity in balance
description: Justice, curiosity and stewardship bound into one reign.
